name: Promise of Aclazotz // Foul Rebirth
oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice a non-Demon creature. If you do, populate. (Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.)
blocked_sentences: Foul Rebirth {2}{B} Sorcery — Adventure: <printed text absent from the packet and from data/catalog/cards.sqlite>

needs.what: scripts/build_card_index.py must carry an Adventure's spell half. The catalog row for this card has layout `adventure`, type line 'Enchantment // Sorcery — Adventure' and cost '{1}{B} // {2}{B}', but its back_name/back_oracle_text are empty and the MTGJSON deck file (BloodRites_LCC) carries only side a, so the packet has `back_face: {}` and no Foul Rebirth text in oracle_text. The second_face entry cannot be authored without inventing its rules text.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The front face is expressible today: an `end_step` trigger whose effect is `may` with `pay: {sacrifice: {types: [Creature], not_subtypes: [Demon]}}` and, on payment, populate as `choose_permanents` (controller you, Creature, is_token) bound with `as` followed by `copy_permanent` over that binding (the shape a shipped populate card in templates.cards.json uses). The engine also already casts Adventures via `second_face` + `adventure: true` + `second_face_zone: hand` (Beanstalk Giant // Fertile Footsteps). The only missing piece is the Adventure half's printed text in the index; a front-only answer would be a half-implemented card.
